system: Covenant Broken Wargear, Armor, and Relic Registry
doctrine: In the ruins of the broken covenant, tools of war are pieced together from dead autonomous warmachines, scavenged medical tech, and hardened relic alloys.

item_emp_lance.name: Overcharged EMP Arc-Lance
item_emp_lance.description: A jury-rigged heavy spear wired to high-voltage capacitors, capable of short-circuiting combat drone chassis and cybernetic implants.

item_scavenged_rail_pistol.name: Scavenged Linear Rail Pistol
item_scavenged_rail_pistol.description: Magnetic accelerator sidearm salvaged from automated factory security rigs, firing depleted uranium slugs.

item_arc_welder_blade.name: Industrial Arc-Welder Vibro-Blade
item_arc_welder_blade.description: Heavy salvage cutter retrofitted into a brutal close-quarters weapon that shears through reinforced composite plates.

item_harmonic_stunner.name: Resonant Harmonic Stunner
item_harmonic_stunner.description: Broadcasts high-frequency disorienting soundwaves calibrated to disrupt both human equilibrium and neural drone telemetry without lethal rupture.

item_lead_lined_trenchcoat.name: Heavy Lead-Lined Scavenger Trenchcoat
item_lead_lined_trenchcoat.description: Durable ballistic duster reinforced with flexible lead sheeting and carbon batting, shielding the wearer against EMP squalls and radioactive fallout.

item_consensus_mesh_armor.name: Consensus Sub-Dermal Poly-Mesh Weave
item_consensus_mesh_armor.description: Flexible electro-reactive mesh engineered by the Iron Consensus to dissipate kinetic impact while interfacing with regional sensory nodes.

item_reinforced_chitin_harness.name: Bio-Hardened Chitin Rig
item_reinforced_chitin_harness.description: Surgically cured exocuticle harvested from mutated bio-chimeras, offering extraordinary deflection against shrapnel and chemical burns.

item_unaligned_diagnostic_pad.name: Unaligned Field Diagnostic Data-Pad
item_unaligned_diagnostic_pad.description: An air-gapped, EMP-shielded logic pad used by Elias to parse corrupted telemetry, calibrate medical synthesis, and evade faction tracking algorithms.

item_dormant_core_shard.name: Dormant Prime Machine Core Shard
item_dormant_core_shard.description: A crystalline memory substrate extracted from the epicenter of the Resonant Void, emitting faint arithmetic harmonics of pre-war civilization.

item_genome_cryo_flask.name: Stabilized Human Genome Cryo-Flask
item_genome_cryo_flask.description: Cryogenically preserved baseline human genetic templates guarded fiercely by Dr. Kora Vance to prevent permanent transhuman mutation.
